title: Bias Audit Report
description: A written report documenting the results of an independent bias audit of an automated employment decision tool, modelled on the audit artifact required by NYC Local Law 144.
evidence_description: A report documenting the methodology and results of a bias audit of an automated employment decision tool, including selection rates by demographic category (e.g. sex, race/ethnicity) and any resulting impact ratios, together with a description of the data used.
collection_method: Independent third-party audit performed by an entity independent of the tool's developer, using historical or representative test candidate data.
retention_period: Minimum 3 years from date of last use, aligned with typical employment record-keeping requirements.
artifact_format: PDF report for public summary disclosure; underlying selection-rate data retained as a structured export (CSV/JSON) for reproducibility.

citations.title: Automated Employment Decision Tools (Local Law 144 rules)
citations.publisher: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP)
citations.locator: Rule implementing NYC Local Law 144-2021 (Bias Audit Law)
citations.excerpt: Employers must enlist an independent auditor to conduct an annual bias audit using historical or test data and publicly publish a report that includes adverse impact results and a description of the data and methodology used.
